# Tokyo Sports Film Award

}}
The  are film-specific prizes awarded solely by the Tokyo Sports.
Categories
There are following categories:
*Best Film
*Best Actor
*Best Actress
*Best Supporting Actor
*Best Supporting Actress
*Best Director
*Best Newcomer
*Best Foreign Film
*Special Award
*Special Film Award
